sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233616, fetched 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233616 ('44 family sites with electric and water hookups') + RIDB catalog (43 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, all Water Hookup Yes; 17 list Electricity Hookup 50, 26 list 30; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 44 family sites with electric and water plus 46 primitive sites without utilities (rec.gov). In the catalog the electric sites are all back-in, 30-76 ft; 11 no-hookup RV sites take 20-35 ft (4 of them pull-through); the rest are tent-only or boat-in. Two vehicles per site, $7/day for an extra vehicle.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233616 (Facilities; notices 'Two vehicles are allowed per campsite', 'A fee of $7/day will be collected for extra vehicles') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Beach, boat ramp, dock, playground, amphitheater and a group picnic shelter.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233616 ('Amenities include flush toilets, showers, drinking water and a dump station. A beach, boat ramp, dock, playground, and amphitheater are also on-site.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 nights in a rolling 30 days (rec.gov stay rule). Park gates closed 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.; no alcohol.
2026 peak season (April 1 - October 30): no-hookup RV site $26, electric/water $36 a night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233616/rates (2026-04-01 to 2026-10-30 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, STANDARD ELECTRIC 36), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the $26 base and the derived 50-amp/water hookups; electric rate is now $36 (was $34). Added 90 sites to 76 ft with some pull-throughs, flush toilets/showers/water/dump, reservable on rec.gov with a 14-night max. Not stated: season, sewer, fcfs, booking window. rec.gov's militaryDiscount flag has no wording, so discounts left alone.
